definition: The programmatic evaluation and dispatch of input prompts to optimal downstream models based on intent, complexity, and cost criteria.
details: Prompt routing prevents over-provisioning inference by triaging user requests using small classification heads or semantic embeddings, reserving large frontier models for complex multi-step reasoning while routing simpler tasks to smaller edge models.

citation.title: FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance
